annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC), Office of Hazard Identification and Reduction
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a four-step approach: screen, assess, analyze, monitor/measure AI/ML in consumer products.
Three-phase build-out of an AI/ML test and evaluation capability at CPSC.
Monitor products for evolution beyond previously deemed safe parameters, triggering re-evaluation.
Recommends inputs to the FY2023 Operating Plan and participation in voluntary standards development.
Recommends collaboration with NIST, ACT-IAC and the Federal AI Interagency Working Group.
annotation.summary_en: CPSC Chief Technologist staff report proposing an applied AI/ML test and evaluation program for consumer products. It sets out a four-step process (screen, assess, analyze, monitor/measure) and a three-phase build-out. It makes recommendations for the FY2023 operating plan and for collaboration and voluntary standards work. The report has not been reviewed by the Commission.
annotation.title_clean: Applied Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Test and Evaluation Program for Consumer Products
